title: A Hybrid Generic Framework for Heart Problem Diagnosis Based on a Machine Learning Paradigm.
summary: A two-stage hybrid ML/DL framework was evaluated on named heart-disease datasets and a separate 299-patient heart-failure survival dataset. This is a retrospective clinical prediction result, not evidence of clinical benefit or deployment.
ai_technology: The paper applies multiple ML/DL classifiers in a two-stage feature-selection and voting framework to clinical heart-disease/survival labels.
